newsitem.title: USA: J.P. Realty completes 1.5 mln share offer.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Realty completes 1.5 mln share offer.

text.p: J.P. Realty Inc said Friday it has completed an offering of 1.5 million common shares, which were sold through Smith Barney.
The underwriter has a 30-day option to buy up to 225,00 additional shares to cover overallotments, it said.
Net proceeds to JP Realty, after the underwriter's discount and expenses and before the exercise of the over-allotment option, will be about $38.6 million, it said.
J.P. Realty owns and operates retail shopping mall properties throughout the Intermountain Region.
